A: Does published N=427 randomised five-arm leaderboard-feedback study identify its full-sample interest/enjoyment mean contrast, if motivation F(4,340) denotes 345 analysable cases?

B.H1: The reported positive complete-case contrast does not sign-identify full N=427 effect with arm-specific unrepresented outcomes unknown (1–5 scale).
B.H0: Every feasible assignment of 82 unrepresented values across reported five arms preserves positive high-up vs no-feedback contrast.
rivals: Reported original significant omnibus condition effect for respondents remains legitimate conditional evidence, distinct from ITT
Authors used complete-case/outlier exclusion; not necessarily attrition caused by intervention
It is possible the F denominator does not represent five-arm complete-case 345; bound is conditional on ordinary ANOVA interpretation

C.population: Five randomized arms in Pickal et al (2026): 86 higher/up; 81 higher/down;75 lower/up;95 lower/down;90 no feedback.
C.outcome: interest/enjoyment 1..5, original means high/up=3.37 and control=3.00 from original published paper section 3.4.
C.analysis_counts: Initial performance F(4,422) implies 427, motivation F(4,340) implies 345, 82 not represented, assuming one-way five-group ANOVA.
C.estimand: Difference of arm-wide means over the 427 five-arm sample, as conditional sensitivity target, not participant-level causal effect.
C.design: Exhaustively enumerate missing counts in focal arms with residual assignable to other 3; treat unrepresented scores as extreme 1 and 5; each arm at least two observed.
negative_controls: Reject arbitrary nonpublished type and impossible N
C.multiplicity: One primary interest contrast, one labeled secondary competence sensitivity. No significance testing or p-value hunting.
C.expected: Observed high-up minus control +0.37; lower <0 and upper >0. Extreme allocation all 82 to one focal arm is feasible conditionally. If not, this AB cycle fails.

D.environment: Local CPython stdlib, fixed files with exact Git SHA1 blob check; no internet needed for run

E: Only after this prereg Git commit, execute python -m unittest -v test_pickal_aggregate_bounds.py and python pickal_aggregate_bounds.py; archive stdout/stderr and exact bounds.
F: Look for ANOVA-case denominator ambiguity, reported participant exclusion, post-randomization conditioning, unreported arm counts, PII absence and method prior art (Manski).
G: No external replication of source-level participant results; original published PDF and prereg OSF exists, no data/code downloaded. Strong published model and prior theoretical bounds.
H: Update source and priors with new original study as negative novelty, and conditional partial-ID bound (not a scientific discovery).
I: No correction of authors' claimed conditional means, no claims about dropout or treatment on all randomized participants, no full sample exactness when missing data allocation unknown.
J: Count one AB-R methodological aggregate reanalysis if prereg tests pass. R5 stop replication claims, release gates 0/6; CT2 remain 22; grade 0/3 unless independent substantive confirmatory evidence obtained.
